name: Trusted Agent [Selfish, Teamwork]
body:
Your supernatural bond to other agents strengthens your resolve and allows you to bolster your allies.

Prerequisite(s): Loyal Agent trait.

Benefit(s): Whenever you are within 30 feet of an ally who is a part of and loyal to your organization, you gain a +1 profane bonus on Reflex and Will saving throws. In addition, once per day as a swift action, you can forfeit the saving throw bonuses granted by this feat to increase the effectiveness of the aid another action. For a number of rounds equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1), when you use the aid another action to aid an ally who is also a part of and loyal to your organization, the bonus you grant to that ally’s AC, attack roll, or skill check is increased to +4 instead of the usual +2. You don’t benefit from the feat’s saving throw bonuses for 24 hours, though you still qualify as having this feat for the purpose of other characters gaining the bonuses.
